description: Semantic Kernel .NET 1.82.0: one GetChatMessageContentAsync call with one tool round, traced by Semantic Kernel's GenAI diagnostics with both AppContext switches on, so the chat spans carry their content as gen_ai.* events.
notes: SK offers every plugin function to the model as <Plugin>-<Function> (1.82.0 has no API to register a function outside a named plugin), so the turn's tool call uses the advertised name WeatherPlugin-get_weather: with the bare get_weather SK does not resolve the call and answers a function-not-defined error instead of running it. SK resolves the prefixed name, and the tool span, gen_ai.tool.name and the echoed tool call all use the bare function name get_weather.
